name: tnfa_corrected_40_L1r4k6
assessment: No pH claim. The binding-coupled protonation calculation that would have ranked pH response FAILED external calibration (12 of 12 tightening on the 12 published complexes measured at 7.4 vs 6.0; direction accuracy equal to a constant predictor), so every pH-direction result is withdrawn. Nothing here has been measured for pH response. Pose quality is EXPLORATORY, not confirmatory: the design loop's pre-registration required a second pose oracle from round 4 onward and Chai-1 was never wired in; all six designs are round-4 descendants. The corrective re-run stopped on its own pre-registered cost ceiling. TWO-ORACLE DISAGREEMENT ON THIS DESIGN: Chai-1 places the binder 26.1 A from its designed backbone where ESMFold2 places it 1.99 A (median of 17 folds). Weight accordingly. Computational candidate, not shown to bind. 83 aa de novo miniprotein. 1 histidine(s). Ranked on worse-of-two-species interface-PAE margin, the only instrument here with an external calibration.
